summary: The customer called angrily demanding to cancel their account immediately due to high bills and poor internet connection. The agent verified the account, attempted to offer a discount which the customer rejected, and successfully processed the cancellation request while informing the customer about a remaining balance of 25 dinars that must be paid to fully close the account.

evidence.text: وبمجرد الدفع رح يتم إغلاق الحساب تلقائياً خلال ساعة.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Account will be closed automatically within an hour once the remaining balance is paid.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك يا أستاذ، أنا بالخدمة وأكيد بساعدك بكل إشي بتحتاجه.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a polite, calm, and professional demeanor throughout the call, even when the customer was frustrated.

evidence.text: أنا بتقبل ملاحظتك وباعتذر عن أي إزعاج سببناه لك
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration and apologized for the inconvenience.

evidence.text: حاضر يا أستاذ، طلبك وصل ورح يتم تنفيذه فوراً.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent efficiently addressed the cancellation request and provided clear instructions on how to clear the remaining balance.

evidence.text: تقدر تدفعه من خلال تطبيقنا أو بأقرب فرع، وبمجرد الدفع رح يتم إغلاق الحساب تلقائياً خلال ساعة.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent communicated the payment options and closing process clearly and concisely.

evidence.text: العفو يا أستاذ، وشكراً لفترة اشتراكك معنا. نتمنى لك التوفيق، مع السلامة.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent closed the call politely with appropriate parting phrases after confirming everything.

evidence.text: ممكن أعطيني رقم الحساب أو رقم الهوية لتأكيد التفاصيل؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent correctly requested account details for verification and accurately explained the remaining charges.

evidence.text: لازم أطرح عليك بعض الأسئلة الإجرائية لإتمام الإلغاء. شو السبب وراء رغبتك بإغلاق الحساب؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed the procedure by verifying the identity and asking for the cancellation reason.
